answer: Locks are entered in trellis, expire in sonnet, and prism lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 148 aliases hence needs 129 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2628 identities would post 3918 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
